Teacher Data:
1- Do not engage in any political, sectarian, or religious discussions.

2- Do not discuss any financial matters with students except for discounts for those who are interested.

3- Adhere to the agreed-upon class time with the student and do not apologize for it except in case of an emergency, and at least five hours before the scheduled time.

4- If the teacher does not attend the class at the agreed-upon time with the student and did not apologize within sufficient time, and the student complained, half of the class price will be deducted from their balance.

5- Commit to completing the full class time, which is a full hour, except if the student wishes to end the class earlier.

6- Do not conduct the class while driving, eating, or working on something else.

7- We pledge to Allah not to communicate with students outside the application except with prior permission from the administration in cases of necessity.

8- We pledge to Allah not to engage in any financial transactions with students whatsoever.

9- I pledge to Allah not to defame the administration or employees and not to promote other platforms other than the application.

10- If you have any complaints or inquiries, please contact technical support directly. If the problem is not resolved, ask them to escalate it to the administration.
